title: Pontificalis liber
shelf_note: An illuminated Italian manuscript Pontifical (rites of ordination, consecration of a bishop, foundation of a church, reconciliation of a cemetery). A genuine primary source of liturgy, but no tradition or collection is given in the packet, so fit to an esoteric/early-science shelf cannot be confirmed.
structure_note: No structure counts in the packet. The run is images 9, 16 and 24, but the leaf numbers on the images jump from 'xxxiiij' (image 9) to 'cc.xxxij' (image 24, OCR reads 'cc.xxxix'): ~200 folios in 15 images, so this is a selective photograph set (excerpted openings), not a complete scan. No translation on any of the three pages.

book_verdict: A handsome illuminated manuscript Pontifical whose OCR is readable on dense text pages (9, 24) but fails on the mixed chant page 16, where a whole antiphon is dropped and 'Nemo' becomes 'Domine'. No page carries a translation.
